verdict.rationale: Firstbase's compliance dashboard shows upcoming deadlines per state and lets users act on them (firstbase-docs-7, firstbase-docs-14, firstbase-docs-22), which covers the 'calendar of deadlines' part, but there is no explicit mention of proactive reminders/notifications before deadlines beyond general 'agency notifications' handling during address switches. Missing for 10: explicit reminder/notification mechanism (email/SMS/alerts) tied to specific deadlines, and independent confirmation the dashboard reliably surfaces all filing deadlines in practice.
